context_requirements: Expression of PKM2 or PKM1 in the assayed cell line
Presence of the relevant allosteric activation pathway for the activator
Metabolic state in which pyruvate kinase activity is limiting for a transcriptional readout
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes in proliferation, cell-cycle, stress, or apoptosis gene programs at 24 h
